headline: Major New Policy Launched! Mortgages Up to 40 Years, Enabling 'Take the Home First, Repay the Loan Later'
summary: A new Chinese policy allows mortgages of up to 40 years, enabling buyers to take possession before repaying. The policy also covers off-plan property, mortgage rates and down payment ratios.
why: China's property sector is a large share of its economy, and mortgage terms directly shape household demand for homes.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: 重磅新政落地！房贷最长 40 年，实现「先拿房、再还贷」
